snippet.title: Problematic: Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Happy to share a quick reveal of the game 'Problematic' coming soon!
Get it on Steam and Epic Games!

Problematic is a gothic party game where someone always goes too far.
Be a fearless judge, or you will be judged, and your friends will reveal their true selves! Fill blanks, judge answers, score points, and secret rules govern the table.
And use your power-ups wisely... You will need it.
